_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator and franchisor of 2,999 properties (535,093 rooms)'; 'The lodging industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts, and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national, and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'if the amount of sales made through Internet intermediaries increases significantly, our business and profitability may be harmed' (its own FY2007 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator and franchisor of 2,999 properties (535,093 rooms)'; 'The lodging industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts, and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national, and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'if the amount of sales made through Internet intermediaries increases significantly, our business and profitability may be harmed' (its own FY2007 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.67x; -10% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.56; conservative 2yr +64%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -45.8%/yr (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.2%/yr (Q1 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.8%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +31.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2008-04-11) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.67x (67.0% downside to Bear $11 / +100.7% upside to Bull $67) | Adj composite 3.30 vs market 1.74: gap +1.56 [UNDERVALUED] | -10% above the EPP floor $37 (18x FY08E $2.05) | Conservative 2-yr case: +64.1% total (+32.1%/yr) | At 16.3x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $44 sits at or below the BASE case; North American RevPAR +6.2% in Q4 2007, forward fee revenue +4.73-6.42% (Q1 2008 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
